entries.name: Making a check
entries.text: Roll d20 + stat modifier. Meet or beat the DC to succeed.

entries.name: Difficulty classes
entries.text: Easy DC 9 · Normal DC 12 · Hard DC 15 · Extreme DC 18.

entries.name: Advantage / disadvantage
entries.text: Roll 2d20 and take the higher (advantage) or lower (disadvantage).

entries.name: Distances
entries.text: Close = 5 ft · Near = up to 30 ft · Far = within sight.

entries.name: Climbing
entries.text: STR or DEX check, move at half speed. Fall if you fail by 5+.

entries.name: Falling
entries.text: 1d6 damage per 10 ft fallen.

entries.name: Swimming
entries.text: Half speed (STR check in rough water). Hold breath CON mod rounds (min 1), then CON check each round or 1d6 damage.

entries.name: Moving through
entries.text: Free through allies; STR or DEX check to move through enemies.

entries.name: Light timers
entries.text: Most light sources burn for 1 hour of REAL time.

entries.name: Torch
entries.text: Lights a near radius. 3 torches make an immovable 8-hour campfire.

entries.name: Lantern
entries.text: Lights double near. Needs an oil flask (1 hour); has a shutter.

entries.name: Total darkness
entries.text: Disadvantage on sight-based tasks. The GM checks for an encounter every crawling round.

entries.name: At 0 HP
entries.text: You fall unconscious and are dying.

entries.name: Death timer
entries.text: You die in 1d4 + CON mod rounds (min 1). On your turn, roll a d20 — a natural 20 means you rise with 1 HP.

entries.name: Stabilize
entries.text: An ally at close range makes a DC 15 INT check; success stops the dying (still unconscious).

entries.name: To rest
entries.text: Sleep 8 hours and consume a ration. Success restores all HP and stat damage.

entries.name: Interruption
entries.text: Each stressful interruption (incl. combat): DC 12 CON check or the rest fails (the ration is still spent).

entries.name: Leveling up
entries.text: You level up at (current level × 10) XP, then XP resets to 0. Level 1→2 at 10 XP, 2→3 at 20 XP … 9→10 at 90 XP.

entries.name: On level up
entries.text: Roll your class hit die and add it to max HP. Gain new title/spells, and a talent roll at levels 1, 3, 5, 7, 9.

entries.name: Spell check
entries.text: d20 + casting stat modifier vs DC 10 + spell tier. Wizard = INT, priest = WIS, witch & Knight of St. Ydris = CHA.

entries.name: Failure
entries.text: The spell can't be cast again until you complete a rest.

entries.name: Natural 1
entries.text: The spell fails badly — roll the class's mishap/curse consequence.

entries.name: Focus
entries.text: Re-check at the start of each of your turns to keep a focus spell going. A failed focus check ends the spell but doesn't lose it.

entries.name: Morale
entries.text: Enemies at half numbers (or a solo at half HP) flee unless they pass a DC 15 WIS check.

entries.name: Gear slots
entries.text: Carry up to STR score or 10 slots, whichever is higher. Most items = 1 slot.

entries.name: Coins
entries.text: 1 gp = 10 sp = 100 cp. 100 coins fill 1 gear slot (first 100 free).

entries.name: Crawling kit
entries.text: 7 gp, 7 slots: backpack, flint & steel, 2 torches, 3 rations, 10 iron spikes, grappling hook, 60' rope.
